note: Events since 1960 from the BFS historized municipality register that changed this municipality or one of its predecessors (municipalities abolished into it, earlier versions of itself). from/to: [bfs_nr, name] of the versions before and after the event. Moves of several predecessors on the same day are one event. District renames and re-registrations without a visible change (same canton, district name and BFS number) are left out.

types.merger: municipalities merged into a new municipality
types.absorption: municipalities absorbed by an existing municipality
